verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same, and both share the same flaws. The bottom row is crammed: '25% off on June 21.' is squeezed against the CTA. The legal text is almost as large as the subcopy and sits tight against the right edge. The phone nearly touches the top and bottom edges, and the decorative circle crowds the sun logo in the top-left corner. A's headline is set larger and pushed up toward the top edge ('Make the / longest day last' leaves a short first line), and it almost runs into the CTA. B keeps the original line break, gives the headline a little more room at the top, and sits slightly calmer overall.
